summary: Linkage Global Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $16,000,000 in Class A ordinary shares through Craft Capital Management LLC. The shares will be sold at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% sales commission, no minimum offering amount, and no escrow arrangement. The board has not issued a recommendation; the filing is a routine shelf takedown. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. There is no special-situation event; this is an ordinary capital-raising transaction with no activist, strategic review, or structural change. What to watch: actual share issuance volume and dilution impact on the low-priced stock.
